indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: People with a stated current-religion response in the area and census year.
indicators.method: All usual residents minus not answered or religion not stated.
indicators.quality_notes: Current religion from NRS council-area tables. 2001 UV16 and 2011 KS209SCb reconcile exactly to the national row; 2022 UV205 carries NRS Statistical Disclosure Control perturbation; the verified national residuals are pinned (+1, -2, -3, +1) and the build stops on drift.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator reporting any current religious affiliation.
indicators.method: 100 * (All usual residents - not answered/not stated - no religion) / (All usual residents - not answered/not stated).
indicators.quality_notes: Current religion from NRS council-area tables. 2001 UV16 and 2011 KS209SCb reconcile exactly to the national row; 2022 UV205 carries NRS Statistical Disclosure Control perturbation; the verified national residuals are pinned (+1, -2, -3, +1) and the build stops on drift.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator reporting no religion.
indicators.method: 100 * No religion / (All usual residents - not answered/not stated).
indicators.quality_notes: Current religion from NRS council-area tables. 2001 UV16 and 2011 KS209SCb reconcile exactly to the national row; 2022 UV205 carries NRS Statistical Disclosure Control perturbation; the verified national residuals are pinned (+1, -2, -3, +1) and the build stops on drift.
